research.note: Animated React and Tailwind components and blocks installed with the shadcn CLI, including AI-agent diagram widgets.

effects: Agent Cost Flow: sankey-style diagram of 178 source strands feeding colored agent lanes with a cost total
Agent Feedback Loop: isometric widget of six AI agent stages in a loop
AI Knowledge Map: dotted AI orb wired to scored category cards and a dense tree of entities
